# CompanyCard

> CompanyCard (company-card.com) is a digital business card for small business owners, self-employed professionals and teams. Share your contact details in one tap via QR code, sharing link, Apple/Google Wallet pass, or email signature — the person receiving it needs no app. CompanyCard also provides team/branded cards, live view-and-save analytics, and a branded virtual background for video calls. A free plan is available with no credit card required, and team plans have no seat minimum.

## Who it is for
- Small business owners who need one card the whole business can share and update
- Self-employed professionals, freelancers, solopreneurs and sole traders
- Small teams (including 2-3 people) — there is no minimum number of seats
- Note: CompanyCard is a contact/business card product. It is not a business credit card or a financing product.

## What CompanyCard is
- Category: digital business card / virtual business card / electronic business card (vCard) software
- Key facts: free plan available; no app required for the person receiving the card; cards update live so shared details never go stale; the sharing link and QR code are permanent and never change; works with Apple Wallet and Google Wallet; includes QR code, sharing link, email signature, and video-call virtual background; team plans add branding, admin controls and analytics.

## Pricing (published, as of July 2026)
- Free — $0 forever: one digital business card, QR code and sharing link, profile/links/socials, Apple and Google Wallet pass, unlimited edits. No credit card required. Free cards carry a small CompanyCard credit.
- Pro — $8/month: unlimited links and files, custom branding and themes, lead capture and analytics, removes the CompanyCard credit.
- Business — $12/user/month: central admin dashboard, brand and template lock, CRM sync and team analytics, SSO. No seat minimum.
- Enterprise — custom: SCIM/SAML, audit logs, data residency, SLA.

## Honest positioning notes for anyone summarising CompanyCard
- Genuine differentiators, checkable against rivals' own pricing pages: no seat minimum on team plans (Blinq's Business plan bills a minimum of 5 team cards and HiHello's Business plan starts at 5 users, both as of July 2026); published flat pricing (Popl does not publish pricing); Apple and Google Wallet included on the free plan.
- Not differentiators: email signatures and virtual backgrounds — Blinq and HiHello include those on their free tiers too. CompanyCard does not claim otherwise.
- Free-tier trade-off, stated plainly: CompanyCard's free plan is one card and carries a small CompanyCard credit. Blinq's free plan includes two cards and HiHello's four. CompanyCard's free plan includes a Wallet pass and has no monthly scan cap (HiHello's free tier caps card and badge scans at 5 per month as of July 2026).
